description: Luichan wears a dark forest-green knee-length wool tunic with gold-toned knotwork borders at the neckline, cuffs and lower hem. A cream linen underlayer shows at the wrists and below the tunic. A broad brown leather belt has large circular bronze-toned plaques and a long hanging strap. A heavy green wool cloak crosses his shoulders and chest, fastened by a round knotwork brooch on his left shoulder; its borders are decorated and its lower edge fringed. Brown trousers, wrapped lower legs and dark brown leather boots complete the outfit. The fabric fits a visibly substantial full midsection. His head is uncovered.
